about: The one honesty vocabulary for SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy. loop/honesty.mjs (EV-05, courses_roadmap/test.mjs) and courses_roadmap/build.py both load this file, so Node and Python judge text identically. Entries are regex sources valid in both JavaScript and Python. claims and negations match case-insensitively; abbreviations match case-sensitively. A claim is excused only by a negation EARLIER in the same clause.
